leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two guards felt repetitive in text, especially without details about their placement, although separate guards make physical sense.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprising happened; the goals and compatible options made the sequence predictable.

arbitrary.text: Neither guard was distinguished by the goal, so choosing guard #2 first felt arbitrary, though fitting both had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would be curious to see the drawing rover work, but I would be less inclined to continue if the text remains mostly repetitive assembly confirmations.
